description: POST /v1/merchants/me/yield-deployments/:id/domains — attaches a custom domain (kind "custom") to a yield deployment. It starts in status "pending" and stays there until the customer's DNS and the TLS certificate are provisioned. 400 for an invalid hostname, 409 when the hostname is already in use. Returns the new domain. Requires a fresh JWT.
name: yield_deployments_domain_add
title: Add a custom domain
